result.topic_en: Gauss gives the addition formulas for the lemniscatic function in proportional (homogeneous) form for the sum and difference of two arguments, then begins studying the sum of integrals of x^2 dX over three arguments whose sum is zero.
result.transcription:
III. S. 421

Lemniscatische Function
$\int\frac{dx}{\sqrt{(1-x^4)}}=\varphi$ , $\int\frac{dX}{\sqrt{(1-X^4)}}=\Phi$
wo
$pp-qq=rr$
$pp+qq=ss$
Es verhalten sich $1$, $x$, $\sqrt{(1-xx)}$, $\sqrt{(1+xx)}$
wie $p$, $q$, $r$, $s$
und $1$, $X$, $\sqrt{(1-X^2)}$, $\sqrt{(1+X^2)}$
wie $P$, $Q$, $R$, $S$
so verhalten sich die $\varphi+\Phi$ entsprechenden Grössen
wie $ppPP+qqQQ$ | $pqRS+rsPQ$ | $prPR-qsQS$ | $psPS+qrQR$
oder $pqRS-rsPQ$ | $qqPP-ppQQ$ | $qrPS-psQR$ | $qsPR-prQS$
oder $prPR+qsQS$ | $qrPS+psQR$ | $ppRR-qqSS$ $=rrPP-ssQQ$ | $2pqPQ+rsRS$
oder $psPS-qrQR$ | $qsPR+prQS$ | $rsRS-2pqPQ$ | $ssPP+rrQQ$ $=ppSS+qqRR$

Es sei
$\mathrm{sl}.X=x$
$\mathrm{sl}.Y=y$
$\mathrm{sl}.Z=z$
und [-X, Y-] $Z$ so von einander abhängig dass $X+Y+Z=0$
Man setze $\int xx\,dX=FX$ und
$FX+FY+FZ=u$
Aus früher vorgekommenen formeln folgt
$xx-zz=yz\sqrt{(1-x^4)}-xy\sqrt{(1-z^4)}$
$[-xx-]yy-zz=xz\sqrt{(1-y^4)}-xy\sqrt{(1-z^4)}$
$xx-yy=yz\sqrt{(1-x^4)}-xz\sqrt{(1-y^4)}$

methods.what: Definition of the lemniscatic integrals φ and Φ
Homogeneous parametrisation of x, sqrt(1-x^2), sqrt(1+x^2) by p,q,r,s with p^2-q^2=r^2, p^2+q^2=s^2
Addition theorem for the lemniscatic sine in projective form: the quantities corresponding to φ+Φ are proportional to the given bilinear expressions (four equivalent rows)
Alternative equivalent forms of the addition formulas
Setup: lemniscatic sines of three arguments summing to zero, and the sum u of integrals of x^2 dX
Relations between x,y,z for X+Y+Z=0 derived from earlier formulas
